setup: osascript -e 'tell application "TextEdit" to quit saving no' || true
instruction: Open TextEdit, write a new document containing exactly: hello AOS. Save it in the folder ~/aos-eval with the name hello.txt.
In Finder, open the folder ~/aos-eval and rename the file a.txt to b.txt.
In Finder, create a new folder named reports inside ~/aos-eval.
In Finder, move the file old.txt in ~/aos-eval to the Trash.
Use the Calculator app to compute 12 times 34 and report the result.

check: osascript -e 'tell application "Safari" to URL of front document' | grep -q example.com

setup: echo 'The quick brown fox 42' > "$HOME/aos-eval/note.txt"; osascript -e 'tell application "TextEdit" to quit saving no' || true
instruction: Copy the text inside ~/aos-eval/note.txt into a new TextEdit document and save it in ~/aos-eval as copy.txt.
Open the Chess app, then quit it.
